workflow.name: Public CCXT quickstart acceptance
workflow.scope: Linux release wheel and bundled CLI; real public market data, backtest, and HTML report. No credentials were supplied, no private APIs were called, and no orders were sent.
workflow.interpretation: OKX and Bitget jobs completed successfully. Binance public exchange initialization was blocked by the hosted runner's HTTP 451 restricted-location eligibility response; this is not a Binance testnet or live acceptance result.

exchange_results.blocked_by: HTTP 451 restricted-location eligibility at the public Binance API

scope_limitations: The artifact digests are GitHub Actions metadata and have not been independently verified against downloaded ZIP bytes.
The successful OKX and Bitget public-data research paths do not prove private API, testnet/live order execution, connector maturity, or strategy profitability.
Binance remains unverified in this runner because of the location eligibility response; no alternate endpoint or bypass was used.
